text: Pellet, Alla Suɓike Aadama (yo o his), O Yamiri Malaa'ika en Makko ɓe sujjani mo, O Suɓii kadi Nuuhu, O Waɗi mo adaaɗo Nuleede e yimɓe leydi ndin, O Suɓii kadi yimɓe Ibraahiima ɓen, O Waɗi Annabaaku ngun heddiingu e jurriiya maɓɓe, O Suɓii kadi yimɓe Imraana ɓen; O Suɓori ɓee ɗoo kala O Ɓurni ɓe e yimɓe jamaanu maɓɓe.
